Frequently asked

Is the free plan actually usable?
Yes. The whole core loop is free: unlimited pomodoros, streaks, Logs, graphs, the leaderboard, and 5 minutes of voice recap a day.
Pro or Max?
Pro triples your recording time and adds a second room. Max is the everything tier: 30 min/day, 5 rooms, unlimited Whizzes, priority AI, weekly insights.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Subscriptions are managed by the App Store or Google Play, and you keep your plan until the period ends.
Do I lose my data if I downgrade?
Never. Streaks, Logs, summaries, and history all stay; extra rooms just go read-only until you upgrade again.
